submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. One native 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game animation sprite, Water Dragon Scholar boy. Image1 is WEST identity/camera/scale guide, image2 definitive identity proving anatomical RIGHT fan and LEFT empty hand, image3 approved PRIMARY hand-painted style, ignore UI. WEST faces SCREEN LEFT in fixed orthographic side profile, camera sees his anatomical LEFT side. Do not mirror EAST imagery. Keep navy straight hair in small tied ponytail, turquoise-gold hair jewel, blue tassels, blue/ivory/gold wave-cloud scholar robes, blue-gold boots, jade on NEAR anatomical LEFT hip, one ivory-blue water-dragon folding fan. Exactly two arms/hands/legs/boots. Far RIGHT hand firmly grips black fan pivot, near LEFT hand EMPTY. Left shoulder chain must visibly connect to EMPTY hand; right far shoulder chain must connect to fan hand.
Animation geometry: fixed full canvas root (50%,95%), invisible floor at y1191 of1254. Match original chibi proportions and head size. No camera rotation, no frame fitting, no whole-body translation. Torso leans 8 degrees left for running, body centered around x627 with pelvis near y820. All body/clothing/fan/tassels inside canvas >30px margin. Character stance height about1110px, head width~540px. Clothing follows motion but both knees/ankles and boots clearly readable. Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi painting, crisp details, alpha transparency, no shadow/ground/text/effects/blur/grid.
Image1 also sets the established corrected hand rig; preserve hand ownership and head size. Frame12/16: RIGHT toe-off. Far RIGHT leg extends back screen-right, toe only contacts y1191 nearx750, heel high. Near LEFT knee drives forward screen-left to x440,y930, its boot off ground at y1080. Opposite arms: FAR RIGHT fan swings forward screen-left in front of chest, NEAR LEFT EMPTY arm swings back screen-right. Fan securely gripped by far hand.
No additional tassel on empty fist. Exactly one fan tassel at fan, one jade hip tassel and original hair tassel. Real independent joint pose, no mirroring or simple pose translation.
